subject: Proposed de-certification of ~37 Certified Pack A Section E clone items (Certified → Archived)

framework_references: governance-guard.js Rule 5 — ≤30 question objects per change-set
BACKUP_PROTOCOL.md — mandatory backup before pack-file edit
CAQS_v1.0.md §1.7.1 — learner-pool eligibility gated by question_state=="Certified"
governance_analysis.legal_basis: §9.2 state transition rules list 'Any State —→ Archived: consolidation or removal from active pool' as an explicit, permitted transition. 'Any State' includes 'Certified' — no exclusion or qualifier exists for the Certified state. The separate rule 'Certified → In Audit: only via explicit re-verification request' applies ONLY when the destination is In Audit; it does not restrict transitions to Archived.
governance_analysis.rule_3_safeguard: §9.2 Rule 3: 'Archival preserves content. Archived questions retain full question text and metadata. Only the state field changes. Rollback logs are maintained in reports/.' This means de-certification is reversible — items can be re-certified by changing question_state back to 'Certified' (via the In Audit pipeline).
governance_analysis.distinction_from_unprocessed_to_archived: S803 handled Unprocessed → Archived (non-learner-pool items). S804 handles Certified → Archived (items currently in the learner delivery pool). The governance difference: Unprocessed items have no learner-pool impact; Certified items are immediately removed from the learner pool upon archival. This is the intended consequence and the purpose of the de-certification.

governance_requirements.user_authorization_basis: AGENTS.md §2: 'No modification of question_state values' without explicit authorization. De-certification is a question_state change.
governance_requirements.revision_history_basis: governance-guard.js Rule 1 (WARN): question_state changes must pair with REVISION_HISTORY.md updates.
governance_requirements.batch_cap_basis: governance-guard.js Rule 5 (BLOCK): ≤30 question objects per change-set without BLOCK-AUTHORIZED marker. Practical headroom of ≤28 recommended per DL-026 remediation precedent.
governance_requirements.seed_preservation_basis: DL-012 remediation proposal: 28 seeds retained as active (Unprocessed or Certified), 112 clones Archived. Same principle applies here — unique seed items representing each topic must remain in the active pool to preserve Domain E coverage.
governance_requirements.backup_basis: BACKUP_PROTOCOL.md: mandatory before every pack-file edit.

batch_plan.total_items: ~37 (exact count TBD — requires precise QID identification before execution)
pre_execution_checks: Verify exact QID list of clone items vs. seed items
Confirm which items are the unique seeds that must remain Certified
Verify no item being de-certified is the sole Domain E representative for its LOS
Confirm backup exists before each batch write

verdict_rationale: The transition Certified → Archived is directly permitted by §9.2 ('Any State → Archived'). No intermediate state is required. All governance safeguards (archival preserves content, rollback possible, batch cap, backup) apply. The only blocker is user authorization per AGENTS.md §2.
user_authorization_prompt: De-certify ~37 Certified Section E clone items (Certified → Archived). Seeds retained as Certified. Domain E coverage preserved through unique seed items. No answer-key changes. Only question_state field modified. Content fully preserved per §9.2 Rule 3. Rollback: set question_state back to "Certified".
